title: task.claimed v1
description: Claim: the seat becomes holder and builder. Records the credential that does the work and the model actually used.

seat_id.description: The claiming seat: the new holder and builder.

credential_id.description: The credential the run starts on, or null for a seat that connects on its own.

model.description: The model actually used, as the credential or seat names it; null when none is set.
